_source: OSRS Wiki: TzHaar-Ket-Rak's_Challenges, Transcript:TzHaar-Ket-Rak, JalTok-Jad, Yt-HurKot, TzHaar (castes), TzRek-Jad; ids are cache gamevals.
_infernoChallenge: Challenges 3 and up need TzKal-Zuk defeated at least once (Wiki).
_arena: A private copy of the Inferno arena (region 9043; the Wiki's 'cave exit during a challenge' is the arena's exit, 2269,5325). Floor x 2257-2285, y 5329-5358 (collision). Player and Jad tiles are calibrated: the Wiki gives none.

arena._supports: The Inferno's rocky supports (rocky_support_multi, as Run.Inferno.js places them), taken out of the copy.

_outside: In front of TzHaar-Ket-Rak's throne (he sits in the wall alcove at 2545,5110, facing west).
_jadStaggerTicks: Calibrated: each Jad's first attack 3 ticks after the one before, as the Inferno's triple Jads (Wiki: so they can be flicked).
_healers: Wiki Yt-HurKot: Inferno healers spawn by their Jad below 175 hitpoints (half), heal 15-24 every 4 ticks in melee distance (Mod Ash), and do not respawn. The count per Jad in the challenges is calibrated to the Inferno's multi-Jad 3.
_ca: Combat Achievements: Wiki TzHaar-Ket-Rak's_Challenges#Combat_Achievements. Seconds are game ticks x 0.6.

messages.noTeleport: You can't teleport out of the challenge.
messages._unverified: noTeleport has no capture behind it.
